cases.name: Jessica Ann Pripstein
cases.about: She was a waitress at Adamo's Pizzeria in Easthampton, MA. "She was very sweet and had her heart on her sleeve," said Rochelle Pripstein, the day after Ryan Welch was sentenced to life in prison for murdering her daughter. "She was a very unedited person. She loved humanity."
cases.relationship: Boyfriend / domestic partner; Coworker / employee / employer
cases.narrative: Her throat was slit to the bone.
